english.title: Solicit another for the purpose of obtaining their sexual services as a prostitute in a street / public place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) solicited another person for the purpose of obtaining their sexual services as a prostitute in a street or public place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 51A of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by section 19 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009.
(ii) Section 51A(2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 provides that reference to a person in a street or public place includes a person in a vehicle in a street or public place.
(iii) Section 51A(4) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 provides that in "street" has the meaning given by section 1(4) of the Street Offences Act 1959."
(iv) Although a non imprisonable offence is offence has been deemed PNC recordable by the Secretary of State as from 30/07/2012. S.I. 2012/1713 refers.
